articles.title: Tuvalu: Tuvalu ruft wegen Treibstoffmangels den Notstand aus
articles.teaser: Aufgrund des Irankriegs drohen dem Inselstaat Versorgungsengpässe. Staatschef Tofiga Vaevalu Falani könnte nun Treibstoff und Energie rationieren.
articles.image_title: Tuvalu: FUNAFUTI, TUVALU - APRIL 4: Tuvalu, with a population of approximately 11,000 located in the South Pacific, is seen on April 5, 2025. Tuvalu, a nation made of nine tiny islands, faces significant threats from climate change. While sea level rise and storm surges threaten the land, warming oceans are causing tuna, a main source of food and income for the nation, to leave the regulated waters around the island. This shift could allow for overfishing as well as significantly impact Tuvalu's people and economy. (Photo by Carolyn Van Houten/The Washington Post via Getty Images)

articles.image_title: Lufthansa: FRANKFURT AM MAIN, GERMANY - APRIL 13: Air travelers look at a parked Lufthansa plane on the first of a two-day strike by Lufthansa pilots on April 13, 2026 in Frankfurt, Germany. The strike is grounding hundreds of Lufthansa and Eurowings passenger flights. The Vereinigung Cockpit (VC) labour union has launched the strike due to what it says are inadequate offers by Lufthansa over pilots' pay and retirement benefits. (Photo by Thomas Lohnes/Getty Images)
